act.name: Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988
act.source_authority: Department of Personnel and Training, Government of India
act.description: Central criminal law addressing bribery, public-servant corruption, investigation, attachment and prosecution safeguards.

sections.title: Offence relating to public servant being bribed.
sections.text: Section 7 concerns a public servant obtaining, accepting or attempting to obtain an undue advantage in the circumstances specified by the Act; consult the linked official text for the complete provision.
sections.plain_language_summary: Accepting or seeking an undue advantage connected with improper public duty is a corruption offence under the statutory conditions.
